title: BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, reporting the issuance of multiple yen-denominated senior notes totaling approximately ¥270.3 billion across six tranches with maturities from 2029 to 2056. The notes were sold pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated April 10, 2026, with Mizuho Securities USA LLC and Merrill Lynch International as underwriters.
key_points: Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥128.9 billion of 2.077% Senior Notes due 2029
Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥86.8 billion of 2.465% Senior Notes due 2031
Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥22.3 billion of 2.739% Senior Notes due 2033
Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥27.3 billion of 3.084% Senior Notes due 2036
Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥2.0 billion of 3.452% Senior Notes due 2041
Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥5.0 billion of 4.037% Senior Notes due 2056
Total aggregate principal across all tranches: approximately ¥270.3 billion
Underwriting agreement entered into April 10, 2026 with Mizuho Securities USA LLC and Merrill Lynch International
